import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0086 {α : Type u_1} {l₁ l₂ : List α} [DecidableEq α] : l₁.Subperm l₂ ↔ ∀ (a : α), List.count a l₁ ≤ List.count a l₂ := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0086 {α : Type u_1} {l₁ l₂ : List α} [DecidableEq α] : l₁.Subperm l₂ ↔ ∀ (a : α), List.count a l₁ ≤ List.count a l₂ := by
  rw [List.subperm_iff_count]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0086 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0086 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0086

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0086
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0086
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
